subject: Priv Stack: CI handoff & module ownership for private deployment
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ivanova <marta@cloudio-partners.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff: private stack CI + ownership questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the VPC/on‑prem flow looks promising. We need to move from evaluation to a controlled handoff: our infra team wants a clear CI/CD owner map for the private stack (Terraform modules, Helm charts, and the Ansible runbooks) and a short plan for gating (unit tests, integration, and preflight checks).

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood provide the CI templates (Jenkins/GitHub Actions) and a short checklist for preflight tests?
- Who at Redwood will be the point owners for Terraform vs Helm vs Ansible for the first two sprints?

Attaching a one‑page summary of our internal rollout timeline — happy to sync on a short call.

Attachments: priv-stack-ci-proposal.pdf (1 page plan)

Regards,
Samir
Lead Cloud Engineer
Acme Analytics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: private stack CI + ownership questions

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. Looping in Markus (infra modules) and Evelyn (deployment CI) to propose owners and the gating checklist.

Quick answers up front:
- We can share the CI templates — primary implementations are in GitHub Actions for upstream repo and a Jenkins job for the on‑prem runner. I’ll attach the template excerpts and links.
- Proposed owners for the initial engagement: Markus for Terraform modules (networking/VPC, subnet, peering), Evelyn for the Helm chart templates and values schema, and I will own the Ansible runbook integration with your on‑prem bastion for the first sprint.

Proposed next step: 30‑minute handoff call Wednesday (Aug 11) to review the gating checklist and confirm pipeline triggers. Marta from CloudIO — want to confirm they’ll run the Jenkins on their appliance?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: private stack CI + ownership questions

Thanks for looping me in. A few concrete notes from the Terraform side after a quick repo scan:

- Module split: We'll keep core networking (vpc, subnets, routing) in the "core-net" module, and put cluster/op components (load balancers, node pool attachments) into "cluster-infra". This keeps the plan sizes bounded.
- State handling: For on‑prem customers we recommend S3‑compatible object storage + Dynamo/Consul lock. If the customer is air‑gapped, we document an alternate local backend pattern in the repo.
- CI gating: plan‑only runs + terraform fmt/tflint in PR workflows; require successful plan & manual approval for apply in the protected branch.

Open question for Samir: can Acme provide an S3‑compatible endpoint for remote state? If not, we’ll publish the local backend pattern doc. Also attaching a small patch with Helm values ordering that I think will reduce churn between Terraform and Helm variable overlap.

Attachments: helm-charts-diff.patch (text patch)

— Markus

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: private stack CI + ownership questions

Small additions from the CI perspective:

- Preflight checklist (summary):
  * Terraform: fmt, tflint, plan (in PR), plan output validation against allowed changes list
  * Helm: lint (helm lint), dry‑run install into a disposable namespace, values schema validation
  * Ansible: ansible‑lint, idempotence smoke (apply twice in a container runner)
  * Integration: boot a minimal cluster in the lab runner and run smoke scripts (cluster readiness, KV cache connectivity, health endpoints)
- Pipeline design: we will publish both GitHub Actions templates and a Jenkinsfile that performs the same steps; Jenkins will be the canonical on‑prem artifact for CloudIO runs.

Dylan — can your team surface a lightweight healthcheck container we can run as part of integration? I can wire the steps into the repo templates.

Evelyn

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: private stack CI + ownership questions

Samir — thanks, all. Summary and action items:

1) Owners: Markus (Terraform/core-net & cluster-infra), Evelyn (Helm templates + CI wiring), Tessa (Ansible runbooks + ops handoff).
2) Deliverables by Aug 18:
   - Repo PR with GitHub Actions + Jenkinsfile templates (Evelyn)
   - Terraform docs: local backend pattern and S3‑compatible guidance (Markus)
   - Ansible runbook integration guide + preflight scripts (Tessa & Dev)
3) Preflight gating: follow Evelyn’s checklist; we will require plan approval on protected branch before any apply.

Proposed meeting: Wed Aug 11 10:00am PT (30m). Marta — please confirm whether CloudIO will run the Jenkins job on their appliance or if Acme prefers Redwood to run the Jenkins runner inside their environment.

Thanks everyone — I’ll create the GH issue and link the PRs to this thread.

Best,
Tessa

On Wed, Aug 11, 2026 at 09:47 AM Marta Ivanova <marta@cloudio-partners.com> wrote:

> Hi Tessa and team,
>
> We can host the Jenkins runner on the CloudIO appliance in the majority of cases. For air‑gapped customers we deploy a packaged runner; we'll need the Jenkinsfile and required container images pushed to your private registry (or we can mirror them).
>
> Marta
> CloudIO Partners
